expand.description: Opt-in complete live named callable. Read anchors at offset/start and ignores limit/end for expansion. Grep ignores -A/-B/-C and paginates unique callable/fallback groups with offset/head_limit. Parse/cap limits are explicit; use expand=none and line windows for oversized bodies.

file_path.description: Workspace-relative path by default; configured filesystem permissions may allow absolute paths. Aliases 'path'/'file'/'query' are also accepted.

limit.description: Max lines to read from offset. The 1-based inclusive 'end_line'/'end' aliases derive limit relative to the effective offset. String-typed numerics (e.g. "228") are accepted.

unresolved.description: Unresolved calls: bounded names plus count, or the same count only. Applies to full/relations; does not change search.caller_context.

view.description: Opt-in presentation: full keeps symbols and source; source returns only live output and skips context work; definitions returns declarations only; relations returns target identities and call/constant relations only. Content-mode grep only.

-A.description: Lines of context after each match.

-B.description: Lines of context before each match.

-C.description: Lines of context before and after (overrides -A/-B).

-n.description: Show line numbers in content mode (default true).

expand.description: Opt-in complete live named callable. Read anchors at offset/start and ignores limit/end for expansion. Grep ignores -A/-B/-C and paginates unique callable/fallback groups with offset/head_limit. Parse/cap limits are explicit; use expand=none and line windows for oversized bodies.

glob.description: Filter files by glob, ripgrep -g style: a slash-less glob like '*.rs' matches at any depth; a glob with a slash is matched relative to path; multiple globs split on whitespace/comma; '!' negates and '{a,b}' expands. Aliases 'include'/'file_pattern' are also accepted.

multiline.description: Allow matches to span lines (default false).

output_mode.description: Default 'content' — matching lines as 'file:line:text' with line numbers (via -n); use it to locate code. 'files_with_matches' returns only the set of matching files. 'count' returns per-file match counts with no line content — for sizing a result set, not for locating code.

path.description: Base directory to search (default '.'); configured filesystem permissions may allow absolute paths.

pattern.description: Regular expression to search for. Escape regex metacharacters to match literal code; this is not a fixed-string mode.

unresolved.description: Unresolved calls: bounded names plus count, or the same count only. Applies to full/relations; does not change search.caller_context.

view.description: Opt-in presentation: full keeps symbols and source; source returns only live output and skips context work; definitions returns declarations only; relations returns target identities and call/constant relations only. Content-mode grep only.

view.source: Live source and filesystem/expansion notices only; skips indexed context and all relation preparation.
view.definitions: # symbols only, no raw source or caller/callee/reference/event preparation.
view.relations: # relations only, target/owner identities and callers/callees/constants; event opt-in extension reserved.

unresolved.list: Same count plus bounded unresolved names; reason is no source-confirmed definition.
unresolved.count: Same unresolved count, skip name-list formatting at annotation producer. Ignored in source/definitions.

expand.callable: Use live UTF-8 source syntax, smallest named containing callable; include attached attributes. No guess on parse failure, anonymous closures use containing named callable.

precedence.read: expand=callable anchors at effective offset/start alias; limit/end alias ignored for expansion. Outside a supported callable return original requested window with explicit unavailable reason.
precedence.grep: expand=callable only with output_mode=content; incompatible non-default controls in count/files mode are rejected. -A/-B/-C ignored, matching/filter rules unchanged. Match buffer is also parsed/rendered.
precedence.pagination: Expanded grep uses stable path/range order and unique callable groups (or unmatched fallback groups) as offset/head_limit units; repeated matches deduplicate. next_offset is a group offset. No expansion: original units unchanged.
precedence.caps: Existing read cap and annotation budgets remain; expanded grep additionally uses read_output_byte_cap. Never split a callable silently; if a body cannot fit, return an explicit unavailable/narrowing notice and exact read range.
precedence.configuration: No persistent options in wave 1; every new behavior is request-scoped and opt-in. search.caller_context remains independent.
